name: The Gauntlet 2004

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the card's own date.

evidence.note: The wing's third annual Gauntlet special, roughly three times the length of a normal broadcast: eight undercard matches (three tag, a submission title hair match, a triple threat, an I Quit match, and a four-way tag title match) plus a Japanese Death Match, before the closing battle royal.

notes: New majority owner Kingston Cash (billed at 75%) introduces himself mid-broadcast, confronts Thunder Valenkov over his work visa, and fires Fast Eddie Cutlass live during the closing battle royal; he also appears unnamed in two earlier backstage segments as a shadowy figure making deals with Blackbird and Lark Fenriz. The VWF 24 Hour and Submission Championships each change hands twice across the broadcast, the second time inside the closing battle royal itself. Commentary and the ring announcer bill Lark Fenriz throughout as the reigning VWF Vegas Heavyweight Champion, both walking into and coming out of his own Japanese Death Match against Sidious The Clown and again at the battle royal's own finish ("the winner and STILL VWF heavyweight champion"); this directly continues an inconsistency already flagged on the previous Firestorm (3 May 2004), since the museum's own record has the championship vacant since Firestorm (26 Feb 2004) pending exactly this kind of tournament. No document read by this lane shows Fenriz actually crowned; no reign is opened or altered for the VWF Heavyweight Championship. A talk-show host, Flash (previously El Gringo Loco), interviews fans and backstage crew across three segments without incident. Sidious The Clown enters with a valet, Spaz, who does not wrestle or interfere.

Awarded to Robbie Caldwell by disqualification after Randall Crane attacked him with a chain before the bell and threw off the referee trying to stop him.

matches.stipulation: Six-man tag
matches.how: Capsman pinned Paddy O'Shea with the Capitol Punishment for The Rhombus.
Caught Iyasu Saku's own top-rope Kiss of Death out of midair and covered for the pin, earning a Rage in the Cage spot; the Riders of the Apocalypse attacked Saku afterward rather than CJB.

matches.stipulation: VWF Submission Championship
matches.how: Won by count-out after an unidentified woman surfaced from the crowd to kiss The Maquilladora mid-match; the title does not change hands on a count-out under the promotion's own house rule.

name: Phear Phantastic 2004

date.source: The post's own dateline is used directly as the broadcast's own date; the document's own internal banner reads November 5, 2004, four days earlier.

evidence.note: A twelve-man battle royal, an unsanctioned cage ambush and a six-fall Rage in the Cage that changes two of the promotion's four championships.

notes: Kingston Cash makes the Number One Contenders match a weapons match for the Rodeo Boys alone. Backstage, Lean Darlene Orion is brushed off by Adam Jennings and Kevin Simmons and slapped by Mark McQueen after he predicts "Pain" for the show, Marcus O'Malley's pet orangutan Bubba consoling him afterward. Jason Storm's own manager Alice springs a remote-controlled cage trap on her brother Pagan, revealed as Melanie Kilpatrick's own kidnapper; Pagan beats Storm bloody and, after Melanie escapes captivity to turn on Alice with a DDT, slams the cage door on Storm's neck and knee and drops the cage's own weight onto his leg, leaving him stretchered out with no formal decision reached. Kingston Cash closes the show applauding Trinity's own celebration.

matches.stipulation: Battle royal for the final three Rage in the Cage spots
matches.how: Lark Fenriz, suspended and uninvited, slid into the ring and dominated regardless, press-slamming Iyasu Saku over the top for the final elimination alongside surviving qualifiers The Phoenix Adam Lazarus and Fast Eddie Cutlass.

matches.stipulation: Number One Contenders match; weapons allowed for the Rodeo Boys only
matches.how: Kenny Kidd branded The Reckoning's face with the same iron used on Marcus O'Malley, and Billy Bones pinned The Salvation.

matches.stipulation: Rage in the Cage; a fall defending Mark McQueen's own half of the VWF Tag Team Championship
matches.how: Submitted Robbie Caldwell with the Devils Snare after Caldwell had Adam Jennings and the 24 Hour Championship nearly locked away in a cobra clutch on the cage's own second floor.

matches.stipulation: Rage in the Cage; a fall for Marcus O'Malley's own half of the VWF Tag Team Championship
matches.how: Pinned Marcus O'Malley after Lark Fenriz, acting alone out of anger, slammed O'Malley on top of him mid-spot, becoming McQueen's new co-champion.

matches.stipulation: Rage in the Cage; a fall for the VWF Submission Championship
matches.how: Submitted The Maquilladora with the Drunken Rage after a Brainbuster, winning the title under the billed name Gods Tears.

matches.stipulation: Rage in the Cage; a fall for the VWF 24 Hour Championship
matches.how: Retained after the cage's own second floor collapsed under both men; Jennings crawled from the wreckage first to make the cover.

matches.stipulation: Rage in the Cage
matches.how: Landed on Classy Joey Boy for the pin right after Lark Fenriz's own Sammael, both men eliminated from the match in the same moment.

matches.stipulation: Rage in the Cage; the final fall, for the VWF Heavyweight Championship
matches.how: Hit a Face Plant through two stacked tables to retain, after Pagan ran in from the crowd with a Final Judgement on Fenriz.

name: Holiday Havoc I

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: Four matches and an unsanctioned cage-side beatdown that hospitalizes three men and gets all of Trinity arrested.

notes: Kingston Cash's proposed tag-title handicap match for Mark McQueen against The Salvation is publicly refused by The Salvation on The Mighty Men's own behalf, leading to a straight singles match instead. Adam Jennings needles Robbie Caldwell in a pre-match interview with Lean Darlene Orion, comparing their ages and experience. An unidentified woman continues stalking The Maquilladora, distracting him during the closing seconds of the eight-man elimination match. The Riders of the Apocalypse are fought off by the Society of Doom and Paddy O'Shea's own group after the 24 Hour Championship match closes in a ten-man brawl. Pagan closes the broadcast with a taped video promo revealing a beaten Fast Eddie Cutlass tied to a cross backstage, canceling his own scheduled six-man tag with Lark Fenriz and Classy Joey Boy against Trinity; The Equalizer and Gods Tears attack all three with a sledgehammer and canoe paddle in an unsanctioned brawl too violent to broadcast, and Las Vegas police arrest all three members of Trinity after Cutlass, Fenriz and Classy Joey Boy are hospitalized.

matches.how: Interrupted when Sebastian, G-Gangsta and Robbie Caldwell ran in and beat down stablemate Iyasu Saku, drawing Paddy O'Shea to his defense; the returning Rodeo Boys then jumped O'Shea from the crowd, and commentary suspected the whole sequence had been staged, until The Mighty Men ran in and cleared the ring with no decision reached.

Caught The Reckoning's missed top-rope Senton Bomb and locked in the Devils Snare for the submission, McQueen defending alone after Kingston Cash's proposed handicap tag match was rejected by The Salvation on The Mighty Men's own behalf.

matches.stipulation: The Rhombus vs. the Riders of the Apocalypse; eight-man elimination
matches.how: Distracted by the unidentified woman who has been stalking him and tazed from outside by Robbie Caldwell, The Maquilladora, the last man standing for The Rhombus, was pinned by Sebastian, the last man standing for the Riders.

eliminations.note: Caught first with the Rodeo Boys' own Double Eight Second Ride, delivered together with Kenny Kidd.
Caught with the Legend Killer.
Tombstoned with the Queenz Crusha.
Covered for the fall after the Riders' own beatdown of the last Rhombus man standing.
Small-packaged after breaking up a Permanent Daylight pin on Sebastian.
Missed a top-rope Missile Dropkick and was pinned.

matches.stipulation: VWF 24 Hour Championship
matches.how: Robbie Caldwell went for the Buckshot but Jennings moved; G-Gangsta was accidentally clocked in the confusion, Jennings hit the Hyper Driver, and pinned Caldwell for the win.

name: Holiday Havoc II

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: A tag team title battle royal won by a surprise returning mystery entrant, and a triple threat ending in an unnamed woman's own pack of wolves chasing off Trinity.

notes: Lark Fenriz opens the broadcast with a taped promo vowing revenge for the previous show's own Trinity attack. Gods Tears pitches Kingston Cash on a self-arranged hardcore invitational built around his own VWF Submission Championship, which Cash agrees to recognize if it comes off cleanly. Fenriz, Fast Eddie Cutlass and Classy Joey Boy each agree to give up their own battle royal entries in exchange for a rematch against Trinity later in the night. A mystery entrant, revealed as a returning Thunder Valenkov -- gone from the VWF since a work-permit lapse -- interrupts the battle royal with a lightning-and-thunder entrance. After the battle royal, Trinity is suspended from the VWF through the end of the year, so what was to be a six-man tag against Fenriz, Cutlass and Classy Joey Boy is rebooked as a triple threat among the three men themselves; The Equalizer runs in mid-match despite the suspension, and after Fenriz pins Cutlass with the Sammael, Gods Tears and Pagan join the post-match attack until an unnamed woman in Native American dress releases three leashed wolves on the group, sending Trinity fleeing along with color commentator Dirk Western.

matches.stipulation: Battle royal for the vacant half of the VWF Tag Team Championship; titleholder Mark McQueen did not compete
matches.how: A mystery entrant revealed as a returning Thunder Valenkov eliminated Sebastian last to win the vacant half of the VWF Tag Team Championship, joining titleholder Mark McQueen.

eliminations.note: Attacked by all five members of the Riders of the Apocalypse as the bell rang and tossed to the outside.
Pulled out of the ring by Jennings after leaning over to laugh at him.
Tossed out shortly after the mystery entrant's own arrival.
Hit with the Urange and tossed over the ropes.
Triple-teamed and tossed by the remaining Riders of the Apocalypse after tag partner The Reckoning left him alone to challenge Valenkov.
Knocked out of the ring alongside The Maquilladora by a charging Roadkill Rick.
Knocked out of the ring alongside Iyasu Saku by a charging Roadkill Rick after the unidentified woman who has been stalking him interfered again.
Sent to the floor with a big clothesline.
Thrown out in one motion after Sonicman got the better of him.
Sent to the floor with a High Back Body Drop.
Tossed after a Tilt-a-Whirl Backbreaker.
A punch ducked, then sent to the floor.
Knocked out with a clothesline.
Turned on by his own tag partner of the summer, caught with a second Legend Killer and thrown out.
An Irish whip reversed into a big boot, then tossed.

matches.stipulation: Triple threat, rebooked from a six-man tag against Trinity after Trinity's own year-end suspension
matches.how: Caught Fast Eddie Cutlass with the Sammael for the pin moments after Cutlass had dived out of the ring to clothesline Pagan, who had run in alongside the rest of Trinity despite the suspension; the bell rang and the ring announcer began to speak before The Equalizer grabbed the microphone and the post-match attack began.

name: New Years Kick Off

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date; the broadcast's own on-screen banner reads "NEWS YEARS KICK OFF," a typo for New Years Kick Off matching the newsgroup subject line.

evidence.note: First broadcast from the Orleans Arena; five matches, G-Gangsta's resignation from the Riders of the Apocalypse, and the on-air arrival of a new VWF guardian, John Tyler.

notes: The broadcast opens backstage on Trinity being interrupted by a passing Sidious The Clown; Ric Beauty, a holdover from the 12 Days Tournament, joins Dan The Man Aller on color commentary for the night. Robbie Caldwell and Sebastian arrive for their own six-man tag without tag partner G-Gangsta, who no-shows the bell; after the match Sebastian calls out Gangsta on the house mic, and Gangsta's own former manager U-Trop appears to announce Gangsta wants no further part of the group, Gangsta himself running in moments later to beat down Sebastian and announce his resignation from the Riders of the Apocalypse on the spot. Sidious The Clown, comically distracted backstage by a food vendor named Spaz, works the main event as special guest referee. Gods Tears is billed the new VWF Hardcore Champion, having proposed the title to Kingston Cash on Holiday Havoc II and staged his own off-page GT's Invitational to win it. During the main event's own chaos, Gods Tears assaults Spaz and Sidious on the arena's own big screens with a lead pipe until a newly arrived special agent, John Tyler, is introduced as the VWF's own guardian for the length of an ongoing FBI investigation, orders Gods Tears to stand down under threat of being stripped of both his titles and suspended, and installs a returning, previously suspended Kagedo as his own on-site enforcer over Trinity.

matches.how: Kicked out of an Eight Second Ride attempt and rolled Billy Bones up with a Small Package for the pin.
Recovered from an early beating to knock Lance Voltar dizzy with an uppercut, then finished him with a top-rope Fist Drop.

matches.stipulation: Six-man tag; the Riders of the Apocalypse a man short after G-Gangsta failed to appear
matches.how: Thunder Valenkov flattened Robbie Caldwell with the Thunder Bomb and tagged in 24 Hour Champion Adam Jennings, who finished Caldwell with the Hyper Driver for the pin.
Both wound up on the arena floor after a missed spear sent The Maquilladora into the ringside table; neither beat the referee's own ten count.

Locked in the Ankle Lock for the tap-out after a big Reckoning comeback, Billy Bones working over the same leg with a chair from ringside throughout; The Reckoning was taken to UMC Medical Center afterward with ligament damage.

matches.stipulation: Trinity vs. Fast Eddie Cutlass and Lark Fenriz's own mystery partner, who never arrived
matches.how: Ruled a no contest after special guest referee Sidious The Clown was knocked from the ring, a returning Kagedo made the save for a pinned Lark Fenriz, and newly arrived special guardian John Tyler ordered Gods Tears -- assaulting Spaz and Sidious on the arena's own big screens with a lead pipe -- to stand down under threat of being stripped of both titles and suspended.

appearances.note: Officiates the main event and is knocked out of the ring by The Equalizer, then attacked on the arena's own big screens by Gods Tears with a lead pipe.

name: Road To Rhyolite

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: Seven matches building toward the Ghost Town Blues PPV, including a VWF Hardcore and Submission Championship match and a VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship triple threat.

notes: Opens with Paddy O'Shea getting Sonicman drunk at a nearby pub before their own match. New VWF guardian John Tyler overrules majority owner Kingston Cash to let 25% owner Classy Joey Boy book himself into the main event. Kingston Cash introduces a man wearing the 12 Days Tournament Silver Medal as newly signed medalist Scott Starring, though the man is a different individual, later identified on air as Henry Fish. Pagan chains, whips and crowns Fast Eddie Cutlass with a barbed-wire "Crown of Thorns" after a tag match interference, ejected from the building by John Tyler and forfeiting his own scheduled match with Lark Fenriz. Kingston Cash works a stretch of the Heavyweight Championship match as guest referee.

matches.how: Both men, still drunk from a pre-match saloon visit, went down together when O'Shea's own Spinning Heel Kick attempt floored them both; neither beat the referee's own ten count. O'Shea challenged Sonicman to a drinking rematch afterward, agreed on the spot as a Rhyolite Saloon Match at Ghost Town Blues.

matches.stipulation: Billed The New Revolution Kenny Kidd and Lance "The Big V" Voltar
matches.how: Locked in the Elko Lasso anklelock for the tap-out after Billy Bones yanked Lance Voltar's ankle from ringside, distracting the referee.

matches.stipulation: Billed CAPSMEN!; the winners earn the right to book their own matches at Ghost Town Blues
matches.how: Robbie Caldwell placed Evil Capsman on the top rope for Sebastian's own Shock and Horror superplex and the pin.

matches.stipulation: Non-title tag match
matches.how: Ruled a no contest after the Riders of the Apocalypse -- Sebastian, Robbie Caldwell and the Rodeo Boys -- ran in on G-Gangsta, their own former member, and stretchered him out of the building.

matches.stipulation: VWF 24 Hour Championship; the challenger billed The Masked Nevadan
matches.how: Finished a game challenger with the Hyper Driver for the pin and the title defense; the loser was unmasked afterward as Billy Bones. Robbie Caldwell then tased the champion from outside, briefly wore the belt himself, and was chased off with Bones by Mark McQueen and Thunder Valenkov.

matches.stipulation: VWF Hardcore and Submission Championship match
matches.how: A brawl that spilled from the ring through the backstage area and onto a concourse merchandise table ended when the blinded referee, talked through the finish by Lark Fenriz, mistook Fenriz's own hand slapping a nearby counter for champion Gods Tears tapping out and awarded the fall to Sidious The Clown; the ring announcer names only the VWF Submission Championship in the decision, leaving the VWF Hardcore Championship unaddressed.

matches.stipulation: VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship; Classy Joey Boy books himself into the match using his own 25% ownership stake
matches.how: Pinned Classy Joey Boy with the Face Plant after majority owner Kingston Cash, working a stretch of the match as guest referee, was punched off the ring apron by The Maquilladora and Sebastian ran in to fell Classy Joey Boy with the Legend Killer.

name: Road To Rhyolite II

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date; the broadcast's own opening line places the taping the afternoon before the Super Bowl.

evidence.note: The in-ring debut of Scott Starring aka Henry Fish, a fatal four-way among four past VWF Vegas Heavyweight Champions, and the nineteen-man Pre Gauntlet Gauntlet, won by Thunder Valenkov for the final entry into The Gauntlet.

notes: Kingston Cash opens the show warning off Yancy Kilpatrick's own ownership group, John Tyler and Classy Joey Boy, then sets Classy Joey Boy and Kagedo to open the Pre Gauntlet Gauntlet against each other. Lean Darlene Orion interviews G-Gangsta backstage after his win, who confirms Ghost Town Blues will be his and Sebastian's own retirement match.

matches.stipulation: Billed Scott Starring aka Henry Fish's own in-ring debut
matches.how: Beat down an overmatched Vegas Vic with fists and kicks before finishing him with a top-rope Starfall Splash.

matches.stipulation: Fatal four-way among four past VWF Vegas Heavyweight Champions
matches.how: Climbed to the top rope for a Gangsta Smash onto both Sebastian and Classy Joey Boy, then covered Sebastian for the pin moments after Sebastian had hit back-to-back Legend Killers on The Maquilladora and Classy Joey Boy.

matches.stipulation: The Pre Gauntlet Gauntlet; a new entrant every two minutes, the winner earning the final entry into The Gauntlet
matches.how: Last man standing after eliminating The Equalizer, both men going over the top rope together with Valenkov landing on the apron and The Equalizer hitting the floor first.

eliminations.note: Driven into the corner and hit with a Hurricanrana before hitting the floor.
Dropkicked off the apron alongside Lark Fenriz, who instead landed on the apron.
Tossed out together with CAPSMAN by Sidious The Clown and Kagedo; climbs back onto the apron immediately after to hit CAPSMAN with his own Big V legdrop and count the fall himself.
Tossed out together with Lance Voltar by Sidious The Clown and Kagedo, then legdropped by the re-entering Voltar, who counts his own pin.
Knocked out with a clothesline.
Caught with the Kiss of Death superkick.
Sent over the top rope and onto the already-eliminated Lark Fenriz with an enziguiri.
Rolled up and flipped over the top rope while working Classy Joey Boy's own ankle with the Elko Lasso.
Suplexed over the top rope after reversing his own attempted vertical suplex.
Sidestepped on a charge and sent to the arena floor.
Caught with a Scissors Kick and tossed out.
Sidestepped on a charge and tossed out.
Rammed into the corner and dumped out after returning from a mid-match beer break.
Caught with an Urange Suplex and thrown out.
Clotheslined out of the ring by his own stablemate, who was aiming for Thunder Valenkov.
Clotheslined out after getting back to his feet.
Bodyslammed over the top rope to the floor.
Held on as both men went over the top rope together; Valenkov landed on the apron, The Equalizer on the floor.

name: Ghost Town Blues 2005

date.source: The post's own dateline is used directly as the card's own date.

evidence.note: The wing's own annual outdoor PPV: eight billed matches plus an impromptu opener, headlined by Sebastian and G-Gangsta's own Steel Cage Double Retirement Match.

notes: An impromptu opening match answers Henry Fish's own demand for a Scott Starring title shot. Kingston Cash's own younger brother poses as a ringside doctor to help The Equalizer retain the VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship in the Wheel Of Chaos main event, revealed by name only after the bell. Retiring VWF originals Sebastian and G-Gangsta are interrupted after their own Steel Cage match by a returning Hot Property.

matches.stipulation: An impromptu opening match, arranged on the spot by VWF guardian John Tyler
matches.how: Henry Fish, billed Scott Starring, demanded a title shot moments after majority owner Kingston Cash exposed him as an impostor; John Tyler answered by sending out Kagedo, who ducked a wild right hand and finished him with a Dragon Suplex.

matches.stipulation: Loser Is Winners Valet Match
matches.how: Voltar missed a top-rope Twisting Corkscrew Legdrop and bumped the referee going for the cover; CAPSMAN recovered first and pinned him with a schoolboy once the referee revived, winning Voltar as his own ringside valet.

matches.stipulation: Rings Of Glory Match; VWF Tag Team Championship, wrestled in two side-by-side rings with tags allowed only after a fall in either one
matches.how: Thunder Valenkov pinned Billy Bones first and joined Mark McQueen's own ring, turning the match into a handicap for Kenny Kidd, who nearly finished McQueen with the Elko Lasso before McQueen tapped out; Valenkov finished Kidd alone with the Thunder Bomb to retain the titles.

matches.stipulation: Rhyolite Saloon Match; first man to finish a pitcher at each of four ringside corners wins
matches.how: Both men reached the fourth and final corner together after trading finishers along the way, but a bartender secretly working O'Shea's corner punched Sonicman in the throat at the last pour, letting O'Shea finish his own fourth pitcher unopposed.

matches.stipulation: VWF Hardcore and Submission Championship; Scaffold Match, won by pinfall, submission, or knocking a man from the scaffold to the ground
matches.how: Sidious The Clown swung out on an overhead rigging line and kicked both other men off the scaffold together; Lark Fenriz hit the ground first, and the match was awarded to Sidious, though the broadcast states neither the VWF Hardcore nor Submission Championship changed hands.

matches.stipulation: Church Of Pain Match (dog collar and barbed-wire ropes)
matches.how: Cutlass fought off interference from Pagan's Trinity stablemates Gods Tears and The Equalizer, who toppled a ringside spotlight onto him and dragged him toward the arena scaffolding before enforcer Kagedo intervened; Cutlass broke free, hit the Guarantee, and rolled Pagan off the side of the scaffolding, and the referee stopped the match when Pagan could not breathe.

matches.stipulation: VWF 24 Hour Championship; Bring Your Own Weapons
matches.how: A brawl through the crowd with fan-supplied weapons ended when ringside legend Johnny "Hands Of" Stone knocked Caldwell down and reclaimed his own prosthetic leg, which Caldwell had been using as a weapon; Jennings finished Caldwell moments later with the Hyper Driver.

matches.stipulation: VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship; Wheel Of Chaos, the stipulation changing every three minutes to a new spin of the wheel
matches.how: The match cycled through ladder, submission-only, loser-leaves-the-VWF and no-disqualification stipulations before landing on a cage stipulation with the bleeding champion one spin from an automatic First Blood loss; a doctor who slipped into the cage to treat him instead injected Classy Joey Boy and The Maquilladora, and The Equalizer pinned both for the win once they collapsed. The doctor was revealed afterward as Kingston Cash's own brother, Terrance Cash.

matches.stipulation: Steel Cage Double Retirement Match
matches.how: Gangsta reversed a back body drop into a bridging pin for the win, ending both men's own VWF careers; Sebastian raised Gangsta's hand afterward, and the two fought off a post-match attack from a returning Hot Property (Stevie Knight and Austin Lee) with a Legend Killer and a Gangsta Smash.

name: March To Madness Results

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: A results recap of eight matches, closing with a Roll Of The Dice segment that sets the card for St Patricks Day Massacre.

notes: A results recap rather than a full broadcast script. The IRS seizes the VWF over misappropriated talent funds traced to majority owner Kingston Cash's own offshore account; John Tyler fires Cash on the spot and takes temporary control of the company. A Roll Of The Dice segment sets five matches for St Patricks Day Massacre, including a five-man elimination match among the losers of the draw.

matches.how: Henry Fish, billed Scott Starring, called for a rematch of a Ghost Town Blues squash; Kagedo rushed him with a clothesline, and Fish was disqualified for a low blow trying to escape.
Bones reversed a Capsman schoolboy attempt and finished him with a Tilt-A-Whirl Backbreaker, which color commentator Dan The Man Aller called the Bronco Buster.
The debuting Mad Bomber, refusing to lock up, detonated a small explosive near the entranceway that knocked Fenriz down, then finished him with a Sit Out Powerbomb.
Kidd caught Cutlass with a small package for the pinfall.
Kenny Kidd distracted the referee while the debuting Mad Bomber blinded Valenkov with a smoke bomb and chaired him from the apron; Caldwell covered him for the win once the smoke cleared.

matches.stipulation: VWF Submission Championship
matches.how: McQueen had Sidious reeling in the Devils Snare when the arena lights cut out entirely; when they came back on, both men were down and Sidious had McQueen out with a sleeper, retaining the title by pinfall.

Two unidentified masked men ran in on Classy Joey Boy and The Maquilladora mid-match, then turned and attacked The Equalizer and Gods Tears as well before fleeing into the crowd; the referee called for the bell without a decision.

matches.stipulation: VWF 24 Hour Championship
matches.how: Jennings had O'Shea up for a Hyper Driver off the second rope when O'Shea's brother Frank punched Jennings to break it up, drawing a disqualification; the O'Sheas then beat Jennings down until a returning Capsman ran in and chased them off.

name: St Patricks Day Massacre

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: Nine matches, including a three-way VWF Tag Team Championship match crashed by the debuting Team Brittania and a bonus tag match replacing an aborted VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship defense.

notes: Lark Fenriz and Evil Capsman are both attacked backstage before the show and withdrawn from a scheduled five-man elimination match, which is further reduced to a one-on-one bout between Robbie Caldwell and Kenny Kidd after Classy Joey Boy is also sidelined by injury. The debuting Team Brittania wins the VWF Tag Team Championship without pinning either champion.

matches.how: Voltar's brass-knuckled brother-in-arms Frank O'Shea struck him from behind to help Paddy toward a cover, but a returning Capsman ran in before any fall was made, fighting off both O'Sheas; no decision was rendered.

matches.stipulation: VWF Submission Championship
matches.how: Hardcore Champion Gods Tears interrupted the introductions, followed in turn by Roadkill Rick, 24 Hour Champion Adam Jennings and The Dark Monster Tai Angela with valet Blackbird; all four converged on Gods Tears, and the scheduled match was abandoned in the chaos.
Angela wore Capsman down with a Camel Clutch and other holds before finishing him with a heart-punch she calls The Darkness.
The Maquilladora confronted Fish over his stolen Scott Starring persona before the bell, then finished him with Permanent Daylight.

matches.stipulation: VWF Hardcore Championship
matches.how: Both men went through a table off the top rope on a Cobra Clutch Suplex and neither answered the referee's ten count; the title stayed with Gods Tears.
Caldwell talked Kidd into lying down for an easy win, then turned it into a real fight once Kidd kicked out and fired back; Caldwell rolled him up for the pin once Kidd went for a sucker punch.

matches.stipulation: VWF 24 Hour Championship
matches.how: Jennings brought a bomb-sniffing dog to the ring; the Bomber, visibly afraid of it, climbed to the top rope rather than let the referee search his pockets and was disqualified.

matches.stipulation: VWF Tag Team Championship
matches.how: The debuting Team Brittania demanded a spot in the match and both other teams' own captains agreed, turning it into a three-way; Justin Davidson pulled Thunder Valenkov out of the ring to stop a cover on Frank O'Shea, and Simon Davidson pinned O'Shea for the titles, neither champion having been pinned.

matches.stipulation: A bonus tag match, booked on the spot after The Equalizer's own scheduled VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship defense against Kagedo was aborted before the bell when Gods Tears attacked Kagedo with a tire iron during his entrance
matches.how: Kagedo nearly finished The Equalizer with Endgame before Gods Tears broke up the pin with the tire iron, drawing a disqualification against The Equalizer and Gods Tears.

name: End Of March

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: The wing's own last surviving broadcast before The Gauntlet 2005, closing a closed-bid auction storyline for the VWF's own ownership.

notes: The Beauty Brothers (Ric, Rob and Rod) attack Classy Joey Boy in the parking lot before the show, and John Tyler books a three-on-one match against them for The Gauntlet. A legal challenge to Team Brittania's own VWF Tag Team Championship win is filed the same night, disputing whether the team was ever a signed, named participant in the St Patricks Day title match; Tyler declines to rule, leaving the question to the auction's own incoming owner. Kenny Kidd forces a tap-out win over Sidious The Clown and is added to a Gauntlet elimination match, now eight men strong.

matches.stipulation: VWF Tag Team Championship
matches.how: With the referee knocked down, the returning Hot Property (Stevie Knight and Austin Lee) ran in from the crowd and helped McQueen finish Mark McQueen's own Property Boom on Simon Davidson; the restored referee called for the bell and disqualified the champions.

matches.stipulation: VWF Hardcore Championship
matches.how: Neither man could score the fall before the time limit expired; the title stayed with Gods Tears.

Rick had Angela beaten after three powerbombs into a Boston Crab, but valet Blackbird got him to break the hold from the apron; Angela crept over and stole the fall with a schoolboy and a handful of tights.
Frank O'Shea kept Capsman busy outside the ring while Paddy climbed to the second rope and finished Voltar with a top-rope fist drop for the pin.
Riders of the Apocalypse stablemate the Mad Bomber blinded The Maquilladora with a flash of light in the corner; Caldwell put her on the top rope and finished her with Shock And Horror.
Kagedo was tackled by Billy Bones as he tried to break up Kenny Kidd's own Elko Lasso on Sidious The Clown, who tapped out just as Kagedo rolled back into the ring.

matches.stipulation: VWF 24 Hour Championship
matches.how: The Bomber, wearing a bulky suit meant to guard against Jennings's own bomb-sniffing dog, fell and could not get back up; Jennings pinned him with a foot.

name: The Gauntlet 2005

date.source: The post's own subject line and dateline agree on the broadcast's own date.

evidence.note: The wing's own last surviving broadcast: nine matches, closing with an on-air sale and rename of the company.

notes: The last broadcast of John Tyler's own ownership era. Stan Klenski debuts with a win over The Mad Bomber; Lance Voltar wins his first match, teaming with CAPSMAN to beat The O'Sheas; Classy Joey Boy beats all three Beauty Brothers by disqualification in a handicap match; a returning Revolution Randall Crane beats Billy Bones by disqualification; The Maquilladora beats Robbie Caldwell. The VWF Tag Team Championship's own disputed status, unresolved since St Patricks Day Massacre, is not settled by either of the broadcast's two tag matches: Team Brittania beats a returning Henry Fish (billed Scott Starring) and an unidentified stand-in wrestling as the absent Van Wild, with Team Brittania's own hired ring announcer, not the broadcast's regular ring announcer, declaring the team champions afterward; and Thunder Valenkov turns on his own tag partner Mark McQueen, billed alongside him as one half of the disputed champions, letting Hot Property win and revealing returning agent Chris Wheeling as the man behind the turn. Roadkill Rick wins the VWF Submission Championship from Sidious The Clown in an eight-man elimination match that also leaves the VWF 24 Hour and Hardcore Championships unchanged. The Equalizer, entering the closing Gauntlet battle royal first by his own request rather than last as tradition dictates, retains the VWF Vegas Heavyweight Championship as the sole survivor of eighteen entrants; The Mad Bomber and Billy Bones, both promised matches earlier in the night, never enter it. The broadcast closes with a returning Jason Storm announcing he has bought the company, destroying the on-screen VWF logo and replacing it with three new letters: V-X-W.
